data.description: Live defect observed 2026-08-12 against deployed build b526d5d56753 (built_at 2026-08-12T08:34:43Z), which matches github/main exactly. An authenticated c11 browser visit to GET /settings/webhooks returns HTTP 200 but renders the shared shell empty state: “Route not found” and “This route is not installed.” The deployed /api/openapi.json also has no webhook paths (only /api/v1/events/{eventId}/comms/* matches the webhook search). MRQ-30/AC-241 specifies this organizer surface and its endpoint CRUD/test/delivery-log flow; implement the missing route/API surface and validate the real browser path, rather than treating the SPA 200 as success.
data.title: Restore /settings/webhooks organizer surface

data.body: Validation evidence: /usr/bin/curl -sS -o /tmp/live-webhooks.html -w "%{http_code}" https://marquee.stage11.dev/settings/webhooks returned 200; the c11 browser rendered Route not found / This route is not installed. The same b526d5d56753 health response reported built_at 2026-08-12T08:34:43.540Z and git rev-parse --short=12 github/main matched b526d5d56753. A jq path inventory of /api/openapi.json returned no key containing webhook.

Board reconciliation 2026-08-12: VERIFIED STILL REAL — stays in backlog, and it is the highest-value genuinely-open bug on the board. Checked against github/main directly. The storage layer exists: migrations/0005_task_cancellation_webhooks.sql creates webhook_endpoints and webhook_deliveries, and src/db/schema.ts carries WebhookDeliveryRow/WebhookEndpointRow and WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_STATUSES. What does not exist is any surface over it: 'git grep -l webhook' across src/api and src/routes returns only health-surface.routes.ts and telemetry.routes.ts, and docs/ROUTES.md lists /settings, /settings/venues, /settings/tasks and /settings/api but no /settings/webhooks.

IMPORTANT NUANCE for whoever picks this up. MRQ-106 (PR #75, merged 14:14Z, AFTER this ticket was filed at 08:43Z) touched the same ground but did NOT implement the surface. It struck /settings/webhooks from docs/ROUTES.md as a route claim that 'shipped false', and its test tests/node/wave-0-sweep.MRQ-106.test.mjs now asserts doesNotMatch(map, /`\/settings\/webhooks`/). So the product stopped advertising a route it never served — an honesty fix, not a feature. MRQ-30/AC-241 still specifies this organizer surface with endpoint CRUD, test-send, and a delivery log. Anyone implementing it must also update that MRQ-106 assertion, which currently forbids the path from appearing in the generated route map; ROUTES.md is generated by 'npm run check:routes' from the route sources, so the path will appear there automatically once a route serves it and the stale assertion will fail loudly. That is the intended signal, not a regression.

Plan authored 2026-08-12 by agent:board-reconciler at the operator's direction ('make a plan yourself then give it to luna to build'), verified against github/main @ 75b871d9. Plan is at .lattice/plans/. Worktree and branch prepared. Builder: codex gpt-5.6-luna at max effort. Three tickets are being built in parallel and the plan states the file-ownership boundary between them explicitly — MRQ-128 owns outbound webhook_endpoints/webhook_deliveries and /settings/webhooks, MRQ-79 owns the inbound Resend route and migration 0013, MRQ-80 owns decisions.ts and the recovery action.

Started implementation in /Users/atin/Projects/Stage11/deployments/Marquee-worktrees/mrq-128-webhooks-surface at github/main 75b871d9. Scope: outbound webhook endpoint CRUD, shown-once secret creation, test-send plus delivery log, route registration and generated-route truth; event-triggered WEBHOOK_QUEUE dispatch remains explicitly out of scope.

Baseline and focused verification: npm ci restored dependencies; baseline npm test reached 837/839 tests and 119/121 files, with only the pre-existing multi-event MRQ-129 and reset-demo timeout failures under concurrent load plus missing-secret warnings. Focused webhooks API (3 tests), UI/route static tests (4 tests), tsc, route generation, design, shell-truth, API checks, and diff checks are green. Continuing with source review and live Worker validation.

On http://127.0.0.1:8787, c11 browser authenticated via demo organizer, visited /settings/webhooks, saw the real organizer surface and explicit dispatcher boundary, created an HTTPS endpoint, saw the whsec_ secret once, and sent a signed test to synthetic https://httpbin.org/status/202. UI showed Signed test delivered with HTTP 202 and a delivery log row delivered / submission.created / 202 / 1 attempt; Worker logs recorded POST /api/v1/events/{eventId}/webhooks/{webhookId}/test 200. No browser errors. Full 10k-row seed stalled under concurrent fleet load, so this proof used a fresh migrated D1 plus a minimal synthetic demo org/event/person/owner fixture; no product or migration changes.

The hermetic fast suite then timed out after 600471ms (budget 45000ms) with repeated missing-secret warnings and RESEND_API_KEY queue exceptions under concurrent fleet load; gate reported failed at hermetic fast suite.
